live_matches.description: The second Test between England and New Zealand at The Oval marks a major transition for both sides, with Joe Root returning as England's captain due to Ben Stokes' absence, and New Zealand entering a new era following Kane Williamson's retirement. Catch all the action from the New Zealand Tour of England 2026, LIVE on Sony LIV.
